name: versions / import control
code:
import sys, numpy, scipy, sympy, matplotlib, control as ct
print(sys.version)
print('numpy',numpy.__version__,'scipy',scipy.__version__,'sympy',sympy.__version__,'matplotlib',matplotlib.__version__,'control',ct.__version__)
assert ct.__version__ == '0.10.2'

name: transfer function / poles / zeros / DC gain
code:
G=ct.tf([1],[1,2,1])
assert np.allclose(ct.poles(G),[-1,-1])
assert len(ct.zeros(G)) == 0
assert np.isclose(ct.dcgain(G),1)
print(G,ct.poles(G),ct.dcgain(G))

name: step / impulse / forced response
code:
G=ct.tf([1],[1,1]); t=np.linspace(0,5,101)
t,y=ct.step_response(G,T=t); assert np.isclose(y[-1],1-np.exp(-5))
t,y=ct.impulse_response(G,T=t); assert np.isclose(y[-1],np.exp(-5))
t,y=ct.forced_response(G,T=t,U=np.ones_like(t)); assert np.isclose(y[-1],1-np.exp(-5))
print('step/impulse/forced analytic values passed')

name: feedback / series / parallel
code:
G=ct.tf([1],[1,1]); T=ct.feedback(G,1)
assert np.allclose(ct.poles(T),[-2]); assert np.isclose(ct.dcgain(T),0.5)
assert np.isclose(ct.dcgain(ct.series(G,G)),1); assert np.isclose(ct.dcgain(ct.parallel(G,G)),2)
print('closed-loop pole -2; gain 0.5')

name: frequency response / Bode / Nyquist / margins
code:
G=ct.tf([1],[1,2,1,0]); w=np.logspace(-2,2,100)
r=ct.frequency_response(G,w); assert len(r.omega)==100
ct.bode_plot(G,w); plt.close('all')
ct.nyquist_plot(G,omega=w); plt.close('all')
gm,pm,wpc,wgc=ct.margin(G); assert np.isclose(gm,2); assert 20<pm<25
print('gain margin',gm,'phase margin',pm)

name: state space / controllability / observability
code:
A=np.array([[0,1],[-2,-3]]); B=np.array([[0],[1]]); C=np.array([[1,0]]); D=np.zeros((1,1))
S=ct.ss(A,B,C,D); assert np.linalg.matrix_rank(ct.ctrb(A,B))==2; assert np.linalg.matrix_rank(ct.obsv(A,C))==2
assert np.isclose(ct.dcgain(S),0.5); print(S)

name: tf to ss / ss to tf (SISO)
code:
G=ct.tf([1],[1,3,2]); S=ct.ss(G); H=ct.tf(S)
assert np.allclose(np.sort_complex(ct.poles(H)),[-2,-1]); assert np.isclose(ct.dcgain(H),0.5)
print('SISO conversions passed')

name: discretization / DLQR / DARE
code:
Sd=ct.sample_system(S,0.1,method='zoh'); K,P,E=ct.dlqr(Sd.A,Sd.B,np.eye(2),np.eye(1),method='scipy')
assert np.all(np.abs(E)<1); R=np.eye(1); Ad=Sd.A; Bd=Sd.B
res=Ad.T@P@Ad-P-Ad.T@P@Bd@np.linalg.solve(R+Bd.T@P@Bd,Bd.T@P@Ad)+np.eye(2)
assert np.linalg.norm(res)<1e-8; print('discrete poles',E)
